XenotypeDef.label: Goa'uld host
XenotypeDef.description: A Goa'uld host is a humanoid body controlled by an adult parasitic symbiote. The symbiote grants increased resilience, rapid recovery, disease resistance and a dramatically extended lifespan. This xenotype is an XML-only prototype: future milestones will represent the Goa'uld as a distinct organism capable of implantation, extraction and transfer between hosts.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A humanoid host possessed and enhanced by an adult Goa'uld symbiote.
